{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Fine-knit jumper: slim crew neck, hip length, long sleeves, deep burgundy #6D2432, merino wool

A-line midi skirt: below the knee, softly flared, charcoal grey #3A3D45, wool crepe

Textured jacket: single-breasted blazer, slightly fitted, hip length, navy-black fleck #2B2F3A, wool tweed

Tights: sheer matte, ankle length, black #1C1C1E, fine nylon-elastane knit

Ankle boots: low block heel, almond toe, black #1C1C1E, smooth leather

Small crossbody bag: structured, compact, black #1C1C1E, smooth leather

Earrings: small hoops, warm gold #C9A24B, polished metal

This outfit sits right in the neat band for an evening out: a refined knit with a skirt, a textured jacket and ankle boots. The burgundy jumper adds depth and warmth that suit an autumn evening and look rich in the theatre's artificial light. The tweed jacket gives a cool autumn evening the layer it needs and adds polish without getting stiff.
